[quote=the_crystalline_empire;61646286][b]August 6, 2028: The Battle of Belgarde Begins[/b][/quote]
[b]Battle of Belgarde[/b]

The region of South Belgarde is now in the twilight of its existence. The Count of Porcéan, the self-proclaimed Regent of La Rosemarche, was now on track to seizing nearly half the region;s territory. The "Gardens" surrounding Wavre, with its strategically critical network of hedges, tunnels, ad hoc fortifications, and hillscapes were now completely in Sallacher control. Soviet forces had surrendered in droves, their arms safely stocked away on piles for imminent transfer to pro-Sallacher militias. All that was left now was to win.

Porcéan, from his forward operating base at "Hotel Carlodun" north of the western Belgardian airbase, was now left with his advisors to plan out the proper course of action to see the total de-communization of Belgarde and, with holy fortuity, the rest of the country. 

According to scouting patrols, Wavre had been heavily barricaded by citizens' militias seemingly hell-bent on preserving their red revolution. Of these barricades, the patrols noted that militia armaments were "largely unspectacular", limited to small arms and vehicles seized from the local armory and barracks of the city. However, Porcéan was nevertheles advised to exercise caution, with scouts remaining certain that militia forces possessed some manner of explosives capable of disabling or even destroying the Palatine Guard's Char 15 tanks.

To help bolster any attempts to breakthrough to the capital, Porcéan would decide to form a new military force in Belgarde constituted by pro-Sallacher forces and gunmen who were willing to fight in exchange for promises of pensions after the war.

The battalion-sized Corps de Maréchaussée would be formed under senatorial proclamation and placed under Sallacher command with an overall manpower of 1,405 men. Porcéan's lieutenant, Hugo de lAuxerrois, would be placed in charge of the Marechaussees for the duration of the campaign, granting its members total sanction to act as a police unit and local military force in occupied Belgarde. Due to budget limitations, the Marechaussees would be mostly clad in the same gear worn by previous soviet forces, if they had gear, and would be only distinguisable from local Rosenmarkket troops by the use of a yellow armband on their right arm.

Together with the initial Sallacher forces, the combined invasion force now sat at almost 8,000 men, and would for a time be the most effective fighting force in the eastern Rose Marches.

On sighting Wavre, the Count of Porcéan would set in motion a series of operations to rapidly overwhelm the city's militia. The Palatine Tank Company would spearhead the initial assault with its ten Char 15 tanks and a dozen AMC 88 APCs, their advance screened by a ferocious barrage of 155 mm howitzers and several companies of Palatines and Maréchaussées. Several [i]Abeille-4[/i] one-way attack drones would also be deployed by Sallacher forces to forcibly dislodge militia forces from the barricades and to destroy any key weapons stockpiles to deplete Wavre's ability to resist the inevitable.

[quote=nueva_hebasvira;61561457][b]Pan Wuloosyan Airlines Flight 11[/b]

[/quote]

Daniel Frostman, Director of the Federal Investigative Bureau, bursts into the President's office. It's a warm spring afternoon, and the President is having his daily afternoon coffee.

"Jesus Frostman, at least knock first, will you?" Julian remarks on the director's urgency before looking up from his coffee

"Anyway, what do you need? Make it quick, would you? I have a press co-"

"Mr. President. A Wuloosyan flight has been hijacked and is currently flying over the White Sea." Frostman bursts out loud, grabbing a chair and pratically throwing it in front of Julian's desk, emptying his briefcase quickly onto the desk

"..." Julian drops his coffee cup, spilling its contents all over the ground

"What...?" He replies

"Yes. Mr. President, at around 1:30 today, or about 10 minutes ago, Pan Wuloosyan Airlines informed us that one of their flights, Flight 11, nicknamed Jankee Clipper was hijacked shortly after leaving Hebasviri. A group of communists from that country has claimed responsibility."

"Get the situation room ready. Where are Eikelbloom, Brunsen, and Riderveld? Do you know?" Julian replies, starkly, rising from his seat.

"Eikelbloom is on her way back from a congressional hearing, chas been alerted and will be here in a few minutes. We believe Riderveld is still at his home in Vanista, so he will have to attend the meeting virtually, Mr. President."

________________________________________________________________________

"HOW DID THIS HAPPEN?" Julian says, yelling at the four assembled in the room

Brunsen raises his hand, "Mr. President, please..."

"No, no, no, you don't get to speak Brunsen. Aircraft and Airport Security is your office, DEPARTMENT OF TRANSPORTATION. You need to explain to me how one of OUR PLANES JUST GOT HIJACKED," Julian says

"I mean, do you know what this is going to do to the public approval of the war. We are already BLEEDING support among independents..." 

"Mr. President. We have reason to believe that it was on Atharchen International for the security failures. Not our end." Frostman begins

"We've already begin preperations to open a line to negotiate with-"

"Oh no no, we are not negotiating with these terrorists." Julian says, motioning towards Riderveld

"What are our options? Militarily." 

"Mr. President. We meant Rosenmarkkee, we've opened a line to negotiate with Rosenmarkkee about what to do with the flight." Eikelbloom says

________________________________________________________________________________________

The Department of State begins attempts to contact its counterparts in Rosenmarkkee and Hebasvirill about what to do about the flight. Meanwhile, 2 F-19s based in Niu Davikianstad are scrambled to monitor the flight, with orders to shoot it down if it makes any attempt to enter Rosenmarkee's actual airspace without clearance from central command. In Wuloosya itself, the entire airspace is closed, and all flights are ordered canceled by the Department of Transportation until the situation is resolved.
